The Darkside Detective, Francis McQueen, and his sidekick Officer Dooley seem to be constantly caught up in the strange and supernatural around the quiet town of Twin Lakes. Using their less than superb police detective skills, the two must confront weird phenomena across nine episodes (cases), each of which present as short point and click narrative adventures.

While there is no overarching narrative, if players do progress through the chapters in sequential order, there are nods back to previous episodes, thus providing a somewhat linear narrative structure to the anthology. While the game is a point and click adventure, the logic puzzles are toned way down, with the main focus of the game being on its comedy writing.

Francis McQueen is a detective of supernatural phenomena, apparently the only one on the police force, and is regularly called to solve cases around the town. Accompanying Francis is Officer Dooley, a man with a very... unique way of looking at the world. Together the two are paired up to deliver an archetypal straight man and fool comedy routine across each episode. Essentially, the writing revolves around making jokes and puns about the environment, and having Dooley say dumb things.

There were a few puns which got a smirk out of me; however, I found the writing to be a bit safe. The game generally keeps its comedy very PG, which makes it an appropriate game for most. Where the writing is at its weakest is its reliance upon 80's reference humor as a crutch for virtually every case. All of the cases are references to famous movies from the 80's such as Gremlins, Poltergeist, etc.

The puzzles of Darkside Detective are very tame. In most circumstances, it is immediately apparent where and how to use the items found on McQueen and Dooley's adventures. In some ways, this defeats the point a bit of a point and click, as there's little in the way of alternate uses for items, or dialogue which expands beyond the initial examination prompt.

Most chapters also feature a small puzzle, simple things like block puzzles, or rewire the circuit type games. These segments are also extremely easy, so most could play these games with little to no outside help.

Overall, I'm not sure I'd generally recommend Darkside Detective. It's a nice game to play if one is short on time, especially because each case can be comfortably beaten within 30 minutes. However, I felt all too often the writing was too reliant upon reference humor, which didn't land as well as I think the writers intended. There's a sequel to the franchise, so I'm hoping to try that out as well some day.

If you´re looking for a quick and relaxing game with a little challenge, this is it. Funny jokes and puns that made me laugh, interesting stories, references that surprised me in a good way due their creativity and being cleverly put. I personally think this is very replayable and has its own unique style and energy. Bought this one and "A Fumble in the Dark" together, looking forward to play that one, too!

My only complaint is how FAST IT ENDED? When the credits rolled and turned to black screen I was FLABBERGASTED :O The game length is just enough BUT NOT ENOUGH for me, why did it ends that fast 😭😭

Really enjoyed this warm cozy detective game. Although it's a point and click game, it's full of enough suspense and puzzles that's challenging enough to solve. Perfect for a quick halloween getaway paired with hot chocolate and fuzzy blankets.

Another must mention is how cozy the soundtrack is?? Fits the ambience of each scene! Truly felt immersed in the story and makes me want to actually go on the adventures with McQueen, Dooley, and Nigel. 10000000 out of 10, definitely worth each bucks I paid!!!

玩法更像是密室逃脱，乐趣主要在于剧情和对话中的笑话、梗和互动，如果能英文游玩效果更佳。建议所有东西都多互动——场景改变后再互动一边以获得最佳体验。
翻译其实不算特别好，虽然我也觉得如此充斥着梗和双关语的内容难以翻译。文本有错位以及对话中含有省略号的句子会莫名卡顿这种陈年老bug估计是不会修了。
好玩，每个单元的案件都很有意思
